verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing platform, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer user-defined scheduled automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no capability for users to schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. It shows only built-in recurring behaviors: managed daily data exports, fixed dunning retry intervals and billing cycles. Subscription edits with scheduled effective dates are one-off actions, not a recurring schedule. These are adjacent features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
